inputs.doc: E-043b-SEED1 · Trains a SECOND xl144 stage-2 head (1024x16, K 24, sunflower-144 = stencil 145) at SEED 1 for 200,000 steps on the EXISTING frozen f3_anchor41M codec, with the stage-2 training pool opened to ALL 481 longitude columns (--train-lon-hold none, recipe xl144-nolonhold) — the MANDATORY seed pair for #414's configuration, which no other head in the archive shares · params 40.693M codec (frozen) + 211.353M head · stage stage-2 · data family3_na025 (C 39, T 516, sha256 adcbe700fb6e…) · arch codec 576x10, 8 heads, d_dec 768, d_z 64, patch 3; head 1024x16, K 24, stencil 145, ring spiral:111,4444,0.71,0.5 · steps x batch stage-1 60,000 x 512 (= f3_anchor41M's own recorded step count, so NOTHING trains in stage 1) then stage-2 200,000 x 256, expdecay peak 1e-3, halflife 40,000, warmup 2,000, cooldown-frac 0 · resume !run-62,run-63 (f3_anchor41M, frozen). WHY: #422 rolled #414's head at corridor _trainlon 0.93933 against the control pair's 0.86754, and #424 (byte-identical re-roll of a KNOWN head on the new code) and #425 (#414's own step-600 milestone, corridor 0.021 blended / 0.030 _trainlon, profile 0.179 -> -0.068) between them showed the evaluator is clean and the flat-and-inflated property is ACQUIRED over training, not structural. What is left between 0.93933 and the paper is exactly CLAUDE.md 3b: n = 1 at a configuration no other head shares, and a number that will headline. The seed pair is mandatory, no exceptions. TWO-SIDED READING, registered before the number exists: read this head's rolled corridor _trainlon against #422's 0.93933 as a PAIR |delta|, against the _trainlon pair noise measured on two independent xl pairs (#417 0.00075, #418 0.00108, pooled sd 0.00066). If |delta| sits in that regime (and inside the xl tier's blended 95% bound of 0.0037), 0.939 is a reproducible property of the all-longitude configuration and becomes quotable as a level, subject to the lead-time and transport qualifications already on the record. If |delta| is large — anywhere near the 0.072 that separates #422 from its control — then 0.93933 is a single-seed excursion, not a property of the configuration, and the E-043b headline dies the way E-005 did. Both outcomes are results and both are cheap at this price. CONTROL: #422's roll of the seed-0 head (corridor _trainlon 0.93933, blended 0.93733) and, one level out, #418's E-032 xl144 pair (0.86700 / 0.86808).
